rating.title: How did it go?

settings.title: Settings

notificationTypes.nearby_tool_requests: Someone nearby needs a tool you own

settings.languageRestart: Switching between English and Hebrew restarts the app so the layout can flip direction.
settings.deleteBody: We'll delete your profile, your listings and your photos. Your past exchanges stay in the other person's history without your name, so their record still makes sense.
settings.deleteGrace: You have 7 days to change your mind — the link in your email will bring you back.
settings.sampleDataHint: Adds a demo borrow and chat to your account so you have something to show. Only works while the demo listings are in place.
settings.sampleDataSkipped: You already have activity, so nothing was added.
settings.moveDemo: Move sample tools to my area
settings.moveDemoHint: The demo listings are in Tel Aviv. This moves all fourteen around wherever you are, keeping the same layout.
settings.moveDemoDone: Moved {{count}} listing here. Pull to refresh the home screen.
settings.moveDemoDone_other: Moved {{count}} listings here. Pull to refresh the home screen.
settings.moveDemoFailed: Couldn't move them — the demo listings may already be gone.
settings.demoBorrow: Have a neighbour ask for my tool
settings.demoBorrowHint: Yael sends a real borrow request for your newest listing, so you can try accepting, handing over, getting it back and rating.
settings.demoBorrowDone: Yael asked to borrow your {{tool}} — it’s in Messages → Requests.
settings.demoBorrowNoTool: List a tool first, then try this again.
settings.demoBorrowAlready: Yael has already asked. Check Messages → Requests.
settings.demoAnswerHint: The seeded owners accept anything you asked them for, so your borrows become real conversations.

safety.medium: Take care with this one — read the owner's instructions before you start.
